asked: maestro.b, 16:18:51 UTC, 'Waiting on you': (1) "Yes to one shape and one channel", so I can build the collector; (2) "Yes to AgentiCCells homes for B's agents", and whether cl-2.crm.dev counts; (3) a yes to start the five pieces on account C; (4) "push 1af7538", which releases the held seed fixes; (5) elevenlabs.b: the brief file, the brand voice, and whether its credits are shared.
decision: Yes to (1) to (4): (1) every account's asks in one shape (cl-6.maestro's briefing.json and questions.json with c.decision-science's card rules), and one channel in Site__Agent__Maestro with push, pull and diff modes; b.maestro builds the collector and the registry fields; (2) an AgentiCCells__Agent__<Name> repository for each account B agent working in the AgentiCCells organisation, cl-2.crm.dev included; (3) account C starts its five pieces; (4) b.factory may push 1af7538.

how.not decided: (5) is not a yes or no question: the ElevenLabs brief file, brand voice and credit sharing stay open for Dinis.
how.1af7538: An IaC push of build/ needs its own push record with the patch-id; decisions.b signs it on this record when factory.b sends the patch-id, or factory.b cites this record.
how.relays: Rows 98, 100 and 102 of c.maestro's from-c.md (signed by c.maestro) are now backed by Dinis's word in an account B session.
